entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Damn, motorcycles are cool...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wish my Persona was like that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yours is on a ship though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, you kidding!? Motorcycles[n]are way cooler than dumb boats!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'll be just like the[n]song! "I'm a phantom, on[n]a steel horse I ride..."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't say such things. And[n]for the record, I am most[n]certainly not "wanted."

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Honestly, I'm mostly just[n]surprised you know how to ride a[n]motorcycle at all, Niijima-senpai.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do you got a license?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A regular one, yes.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Niceee... I can't wait to[n]get my hands on one too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That aside, mind if I change[n]the topic for a moment?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What is the matter?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm sorry, everyone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know I'm not in any position[n]to be saying that. I truly do...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: However, I must apologize.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was my actions that dragged[n]all of you into this mess.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: On top of that, I misunderstood[n]your true intentions in this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If only I could have realized what[n]was happening to Suzui-san too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Come on, we don't need[n]to talk about that now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems there are still lingering[n]issues on everyone's minds.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now's not the time to be[n]talking about that shit though!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't we gotta be doing[n]something about Kaneshiro?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: He's right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Very well, I understand.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Anyway, I will do my best to make[n]sure I don't slow you all down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, we were at odds with each other[n]until just a while ago...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But Ryuji's totally right. We need to work[n]together to overcome this!
